title: Vercel Pro to self-hosted CapRover
summary: CapRover is the oldest and calmest of the self-hosted deploy platforms. It is also the least fashionable, which is often a recommendation.

you_lose: Vercel's edge network, which a single box does not replicate
Automatic image optimisation and instant cache invalidation
Next.js features that exist because Vercel builds both halves
you_gain: A fixed bill instead of usage billing that can spike overnight
Free seats, including for people who only read logs
A mature, boring codebase — CapRover has been doing this since 2017

caveats: Global latency-sensitive traffic is the case this loses regardless of price. Put Cloudflare in front or stay on Vercel.
CapRover is built on Docker Swarm, which is stable but effectively frozen. That is fine for a single box and a poor foundation for a cluster.
The $20 per seat excludes usage overages. If bandwidth is why you are reading this, your real bill is higher and this page understates the saving.
